text:
Alex: Quick async on Lisbon region (lis-1) handoff — short checklist and ownership. We need owners for: KMS key provisioning, DB read-replica setup (eu-west peering), and routing policy change. Can owners ack?
Priya: I'm taking routing policy + router ACLs. Will post the policy diff by EOD. @Matt will need a CR for the bgp export change.
Jo: KMS is my area — I can provision the key in customer's proj. Need the key alias and residency scope. Sofia can you confirm if we need HSM-backed key or regular KMS?
Sofia: For this customer it's HSM required. Ticket created: KMS-4832. ETA provisioning Wed 09:00 UTC. @Alex add alias `projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/lis-1/cryptoKeys/lis-1-reg` to your infra docs.
Alex: adding alias now. Matt, can you pick up DB read-replica schedule? We'll need async schema snapshot + replication window (2h maintenance) to avoid high token load.
Matt: On it. I'll open a PR for the replica terraform module and ping for CR. CR rough diff:
```
module "db-replica-lis" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@github.com/redwood/infrastructure.git//modules/db-replica"
  region = "lis-1"
  replica_count = 1
  apply_window = "02:00-04:00"
}
```
Expect PR by tomorrow morning. @Priya please confirm peering routes ok.
Priya: Peering ok. Need a small route policy change: prepend local-preference on lis-1 for traffic residency. Policy snippet:
`set local-preference 200 if region == "lis-1" and service == "inference"`
Jo: firewall team, heads up: we'll open port 443 for lis-1 collector nodes from REDWOOD_VPC ranges. @eng-sre FYI.
deploy-bot: infra pipeline triggered: terraform-plan #3456 for branch `feat/lis-replica` — plan succeeded with 2 additions. (link: https://ci.redwood/3456)
Alex: outstanding blockers: 1) KMS alias confirmation (Sofia) — done, 2) DB replica CR (Matt) — in flight, 3) Routing policy CR (Priya -> Matt review) — queued. If anyone can't meet ETA, call it out here. :thumbsup:
Matt: FYI I'll request a 30m sync if CR needs live review. Otherwise async is fine.
Sofia: KMS note: customer requires audit logs sent to their SIEM — adding to KMS ticket.
Alex: thanks all. I'll update the region rollout doc and tag owners. Next milestone: smoke tests in staging on Thu 15:00 UTC. Please mark blockers before Wed EOD.
Jo: acked. Will follow up on firewall rules.
Priya: acked.
Matt: acked.
Sofia: acked.
Alex: closing this thread, will ping again when PRs are green. :rocket:
